findings.title: Shop-window journey check passes without scrolling
findings.problem: The new regression step clicks 'Peek in the shop window' then asserts `section#window` is `toBeInViewport()` with Playwright's default ratio, which passes when any sliver of the section is visible. The section sits directly below the hero and ribbon (Landing.tsx:107) and the hero has no min-height, so at the Desktop Chrome viewport its top edge may already be on screen before the click.
findings.impact: If the section already peeks into the first screen, the journey passes even when the anchor does not scroll, so a regression of issue #37 would go undetected by the browser check that is meant to prove the fix. Reachability unconfirmed: whether a sliver shows depends on rendered hero height, which could not be established from source.
findings.recommendation: Make the step prove the page actually moved: e.g. record `window.scrollY` before the click and `await expect.poll(() => page.evaluate(() => window.scrollY)).toBeGreaterThan(before)`, and/or assert the favourites heading with `toBeInViewport({ ratio: 0.5 })` (or check the section's top is near the viewport top), so a regression of issue #37 fails the journey.
findings.check_notes: visitor.spec.ts:22-24 records scrollY before the click and expect.poll asserts it increases before the toBeInViewport check
